author: cms-sw
body:
This backports Tensorflow 2.21.0 from CMSSW_20_1_TF_X IBs. This includes following changes
- abseil-cpp 20250814.1
- acts 46.8.1: Taken directly from upstream release
- Bazel 7.7.0: Used pre-build binaries instead of build from sources
- eigen 5.0.1: Taken directly from upstream, hopefully this will avoid large CMS patch which we maintained in our fork of Eigen
- flatbuffers 25.9.23
- grpc 1.82.0
- protobuf 6.31.1
- Tensorflow 2.21.0
- tensorboard 2.20.0

This also requires CMSSW update for Protobuf
title: Tensorflow 2.21 and related changes
